question: Should this issue remain the broad memory-management consistency tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 and memory MVP issues handle slices, or should maintainers narrow it to a specific config/API contract?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory config, plugin ownership, doctor migration, docs, and memory lifecycle semantics, which requires product/API ownership rather than a small bug fix.

options.title: Keep As Broad Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until the role-slot, backend, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge.

options.title: Narrow To Role Slots
options.body: Close or relabel this after explicitly declaring https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and its PR the canonical remaining architecture work.

options.title: Define memory.type
options.body: Sponsor a smaller config design around builtin-only, qmd-only, and mixed modes, accepting that it may not solve plugin role ownership by itself.

recommendation.title: Keep As Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until the role-slot, backend, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory/runtime/docs ownership makes steipete the strongest visible routing candidate for the product/API contract decision.
